title: Pragmatic Inference Chain (PIC) Improving LLMs’ Reasoning of Authentic Implicit Toxic Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to classify implicit gender-targeted toxicity (women-targeted, men-targeted, anti-toxicity, and non-toxic) using a custom dataset of authentic Chinese social media post-comment pairs, and measuring performance improvements using a novel prompting method called Pragmatic Inference Chain (PIC).
